title: FeNO–eosinophil interaction did not improve cross-cycle current-asthma prediction beyond additive biomarkers and spirometry
abstract: In NHANES 2007–2008 to separately recruited 2009–2010 adults (n=3755/4354), adding a FeNO-by-blood-eosinophil spline interaction changed weighted current-asthma Brier score from 0.056793 to 0.056964, delta +0.000170 (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.000543,+0.001734]). The registered improvement criterion failed.
